BMW 5 Series 520d specifications. The G30 replaced the F10 in 2017. In the UK the 520d is rated at 190 hp
and the US market never got the 520d. Maximum power 190 hp (140 kW). Torque 400 Nm. Curb weight 1,615 kg.
0-100 km/h 7.5 s. This page covers several markets and model years; check your local specification.
